items.title: Spiegle Willcox and Al Gallodoro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Norwich, New York, November 14, 1995
items.q: Now in 1923, when Sammy, he would sit there, I’m talking about Paul Whiteman’s band in the Ballet Royal

ctx.x: When I joined Toscannini, in 1942, Sammy Lewis was the first trombone player.

Yeah, and you see that was before the microphone. Now in 1923, when Sammy, he would sit there, I’m talking about Paul Whiteman’s band in the Ballet Royal, and when he had a chorus he had a like a canary cage with a big megaphone and a small end, and so
here he is and it’s his turn to play, he just leans over and packs that trombone into the small end of that, and that’s the way the PA systems were. They didn’t have mics.
